reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: GET is an exported Next.js App Router route handler (public/exported API exception — framework dispatches all /auth/callback requests to it directly). Gate 2: BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json defines no trust_assumptions; the attack entry point is user-controlled FormData in signInWithDiscord (actions.ts:277). Gate 3: src/app/auth/ and src/app/actions.ts are both explicitly in scope. An attacker can trigger this via the signInWithDiscord server action by submitting a form with next=@evil.com/phishing, which sets the auth_next cookie; after the victim completes Discord OAuth, route.ts:151 issues NextResponse.redirect('https://<origin>@evil.com/phishing'), which all major browsers interpret as a redirect to evil.com due to RFC 3986 userinfo syntax — enabling phishing or credential harvesting against authenticated users.
